scientific_integrity: Algebraic assertions verified symbolically; global sign and asymptotic arguments stated explicitly. Online journal publication on 2024-04-05 predates the dated first arXiv submission on 2024-04-11; the former is the earliest verified public appearance. No independent review or physical experiments are claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact transport optimization only for the four-direction slit coefficient with positive rotational time and a>0, not an assertion for generic continuous-angle swimmers or arbitrary porous media. Subcritical finite maximizer uniqueness is not claimed. An unindexed derivation may have been missed.
title: Sharp phase boundary and tricritical optimizer scaling for slit-confined run-and-tumble diffusion
